doctrine: BOP panel physics. Three button grades: SEAL (solid), HOLD (dashed border), VOID (only red, hold-to-confirm). 2px travel, 90ms mechanical, no bounce.

tactile_physics.name: BOP_panel
tactile_physics.rationale: Machined key feel — every button is a physical switch
tactile_physics.transitions: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1)
tactile_physics.easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) — snappy-out, decelerating to rest. Avoid ease-in-out (too soft).

loading.shadow: pulse — 0 1px 0 dark → 0 3px 0 dark → 0 1px 0 dark (1.2s infinite ease-in-out)
loading.inner_span: shimmer via linear-gradient masked to text

seal.name: SEAL — solid
seal.use: ratified actions, confirmed verdicts, primary CTAs
seal.rationale: Solid border = ratified. The action has passed F8 + F11.

hold.name: HOLD — dashed border
hold.use: not yet ratified, awaiting sovereign, draft state
hold.rationale: Dashed = the seal is pending. The action has not yet passed F13.

void.name: VOID — the only red button
void.rationale: 800ms = real preventer feel, like a circuit breaker. Prevents accidental destruction. Only red surface on the page.

trinity_tile.use: Primary navigation primitive (3 tiles in a row on home, 1 tile per scope page)

organ_card.use: Inside scope pages for child organs
internal_anatomy: port + status dot (mono, 12px; green/red dot = port health)
'MCP for this surface' link (Button — ghost, agent-side bonus)

surface_card.use: Content surfaces (not navigation). Flatter, no domain tint.

tooltip.rest: position=absolute, padding=6px 10px, bg=--surface-fg, fg=white, font=--type-mono 12px, corner=--corner-subtle 4px, shadow=0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.15), opacity=0, pointer-events=none

lint_rules.name: red_ration_buttons
lint_rules.rule: only VOID buttons use --red-500. No SEAL or HOLD button uses red.

lint_rules.name: bop_travel_required
lint_rules.rule: all interactive elements must have rest + hover + active states with translateY transitions
